title: Fix z3 model value comparisons in test_z3_gradual_types
body: z3's Solver.model()[const].arg(i).arg(j) returns an ArithRef (e.g. IntNumRef), not a Python int. Comparing an ArithRef to a Python int with != produces a z3 BoolRef, which is always truthy in a Python `if`, so every `if ... != expected: raise AssertionError` guard fired unconditionally and the cases failed spuriously even when the solver produced the correct value. Convert z3 numerics to Python ints with .as_long() before comparing. For the two checks that compare z3 expressions for equality (where .as_long() does not apply), evaluate with z3.is_true(z3.simplify(a == b)) to get a real Python bool.
